verdicts.text: Pulumi Cloud customers can additionally publish an executable-based package to the Private Registry via `pulumi package publish`.
verdicts.evidence: The auto-generated CLI reference says `pulumi package publish` "publishes a package to the Private Registry. The package can be a provider or a schema." It also says "When <provider> is specified as a local path, Pulumi executes the provider binary to extract its package schema", and the `--server` flag takes a URL to download the plugin from. That covers publishing an executable/binary plugin package. The Private Registry is a Pulumi Cloud feature, so limiting the claim to Pulumi Cloud customers is consistent. The GitHub code search hit a rate limit, so I did not check the source.
